'''Het Nkik''' was a [[Jawa]] from [[Tatooine]]. Nkik was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] arrived in search of a [[pilot]] to take them to the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]].<ref name="A New Hope" />

==Behind the scenes==
Het Nkik was portrayed by [[Simon Henderson]]<ref name="ShowMaster">{{WebCite|url=https://www.showmasterssales.com/collections/star-wars/products/simon-henderson-10x8-signed-in-silver-image-a|text=Simon Henderson 10X8 Signed in Silver - Star Wars|work=[http://showmasterssales.com Showmasters Comic Con Official Autograph Shop]|archivedate=20240723072556}}</ref> in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="A New Hope" />
